chunks: The Shaykh, may Allah have mercy on him, informed me from Abū al-Qāsim Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad, from his father, from Saʿd ibn ʿAbd Allāh, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from Ibrāhīm ibn Abī Maḥmūd, from al-Riḍā عليه السلام, who said:
I heard him saying regarding istinjāʾ: what is ظاهر on the anus is washed, and the fingertip is not inserted into it.

Al-Ḥusayn ibn ʿUbayd Allāh informed me from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from his father, from Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī ibn Maḥbūb; and from Ibrāhīm ibn Muḥammad, from his father, from Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī ibn Maḥbūb, from Hārūn ibn Muslim, from Masʿadah ibn Ziyād, from Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad, from his father, from his forefathers عليهم السلام:

The Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم said to one of his wives: Instruct the believing women to perform istinjāʾ with water and to do it thoroughly, for it is a purifier for the surrounding areas and removes hemorrhoids.

And by this chain, from Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī ibn Maḥbūb, from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥusayn, from Muḥammad ibn ʿAbd Allāh ibn Zurārah, from ʿĪsā ibn ʿAbd Allāh, from his father, from his grandfather, from ʿAlī عليه السلام:
He said: The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم said: When one of you performs istinjāʾ, then let him make it an odd number with them when water is not available.

And by this chain, from Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā, from Muḥammad ibn Aḥmad ibn Yaḥyā, from Aḥmad ibn al-Ḥasan ibn ʿAlī ibn Faḍḍāl, from ʿAmr ibn Saʿīd, from Muṣaddaq ibn Ṣadaqah, from ʿAmmār al-Sābāṭī, from Abī ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام:

Regarding a man who forgets to wash his anus with water until he has prayed, though he had wiped himself with three stones, he said: If he is still within the time of that prayer, then he should repeat the prayer and repeat the wudu (ablution); but if the time of that prayer which he performed has passed, then his prayer has been valid, and he should perform wudu (ablution) for the prayer he is to face next. And regarding a man from whom wind exits, must he perform istinjāʾ? He said: No. He also said: When a man urinates and nothing else exits from him, then only his urethral outlet must be washed, and he does not wash his seat. And if something exits from his seat and he does not urinate, then only the seat must be washed, and he does not wash the urethral outlet. And he said: He only has to wash what is outwardly visible of it, and he does not have to wash its inner part.

key_terms.أَحْجَارٍ: stones used for cleaning when water is unavailable
key_terms.الِاسْتِنْجَاءِ: ritual cleaning of the private area after relieving oneself

ai.seo_question: What do Shia hadith say about washing in istinjāʾ and whether the inner part must be cleaned?
ai.summary: These narrations address the fiqh of istinjāʾ and define the extent of washing after relieving oneself. They distinguish between what must be washed with water, what may be cleaned with stones when water is unavailable, and clarify that only the outward visible area is washed, not the interior.
